svg.title: ThrottledForLoopLogging: a for loop, the library, and what reaches ILogger
svg.desc: A loop over 18 orders submits a started event and a succeeded or failed event for every item. The library always writes the first event, then holds only the most recent one and writes it when a count or time threshold is reached. Failures travel through their own tighter channel. When one item hangs, the held event is written again as a heartbeat with new=False.
svg.text: A scripted run through the real library on a fake clock. Every console line is its own output, wrapped to fit.
Thresholds scaled down to fit: progress every 8 events or 4 s, failures every 3 events or 2 s. The defaults are 500 events or 10 s, and 50 failures or 5 s.

g.text: ImportOrders item order-6 failed — 1 failures so far,

ImportOrders item order-11 failed — 4 failures so far,
ImportOrders finished with failures — 4 of 18 failed
